name: calculate-turnover-tax-south-africa
description: Calculate South African turnover tax for micro businesses (annual turnover up to R2.3m), check qualification, and compare against the standard tax regime.
requires_human_steps: Register for turnover tax with SARS (form TT01 / eFiling) - registration windows apply
Confirm the not_checked Sixth Schedule rules (capital disposals, partnership edge rules) with a registered tax practitioner
Confirm the regime choice with a registered tax practitioner before electing turnover tax
rule_basis: Sixth Schedule to the Income Tax Act (turnover tax); SARS 2027 + 2026 rate tables; Budget 2026 qualifying-limit increase to R2.3m (SARS effective date 1 April 2026)
